messages.en: I'm at your front gate. Can you let me in?
Sure, hang on a sec. I'm coming out now.

senses.en_definition: The early part of the day; morning. Also used in clock times to indicate the hours after midnight and before noon.

messages.en: Want to grab breakfast at our usual place tomorrow morning? Eight as usual?
Sure. If I'm running a bit late, just go ahead and order.

senses.en_definition: A brave warrior, fighter, or defender; a hero.

messages.en: Amir's playing a warrior in his school performance tomorrow. He can't wait to put on his traditional Malay headdress 😂
He's going to look so cute! Make sure you take lots of photos and send me some too.
The pipe under the kitchen sink is leaking.
I've already turned off the water. Shall I call a plumber now?
